---
title: "Total Ammonia (N) Report"
format: html
params:
  batch_value: "Total Ammonia (N)"  # must match value in generate_batch_qmds.R
  batch_name: "SEACARParameterCompare"
---

```{R, get data for params$batch_value}
#| code-summary: get data for params$batch_value
source(here::here(glue::glue("{params$batch_name}/getData.R")))

# returns two dataframes in a named list
dfs <- getData(params$batch_value)
```

```{R, compare column names}
#| code-summary: compare column names
c1 <- colnames(dfs$SEACAR_STD)
c2 <- colnames(dfs$OLD)

comparison <- data.frame(
  column = union(c1, c2),
  in_SEACAR = union(c1, c2) %in% c1,
  in_OLD    = union(c1, c2) %in% c2
)

print(comparison)
```


```{R, show comparison of unique units}
#| code-summary: show comparison of unique units
library(dplyr)

u1 <- unique(dfs$SEACAR_STD$ParameterUnits)
u2 <- unique(dfs$OLD$ParameterUnits)

comparison <- tibble(value = union(u1, u2)) %>%
  mutate(
    in_SEACAR = value %in% u1,
    in_OLD    = value %in% u2
  )

print(comparison)
```

```{R, split violin plot comparison of values}
#| code-summary: split violin plot comparison of values
library(ggplot2)

# Combine dataframes with a source column
df_combined <- bind_rows(
  dfs$SEACAR_STD %>% mutate(source = "SEACAR_STD"),
  dfs$OLD %>% mutate(source = "OLD_STD")
)

# Create split violin plot
ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = source, y = Value, fill = source)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Value Distribution Comparison",
    x = "Dataset",
    y = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
